title: Concept: Link to a private key file
description: A link whose target is a private key or certificate bundle in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: Downloading the file hands over the private half of a key pair, which authenticates the service or the client for as long as the certificate is trusted.
applicability: Support portals, deployment guides and file browsers.
risk: A private key is a durable credential that survives every password change.
